weekOf: May 14th to May 21st (Not live until ~5am EDT on May 14th)
introMessages: Get ready for two weeks of Motor Madness to engulf Los Santos with Quadruple Rewards on Land Races, a triple payout for completing the HSW Time Trial, and rare prizes for purchasing premium rides at showrooms and podiums citywide.
Beyond the racing scene, earn supplemental income salvaging unused rides, claim a Salvage Yard Robbery Target as a personal vehicle, reconnect with auto mogul Simeon Yetarian, and more.
Make your next photo finish one to remember by wrapping your Vapid FMJ MK V in the new Water Like livery.
Also, we’re excited to share that Old School Hits is now here to stay — play GTA Series Videos’ Community Mission anytime through the Jobs menu.
prizeRideChallenge: Place Top 5 in 5 Races in the LS Car Meet Series
weeklyChallenge: Win any two Races to receive the Dark Manor Racing Suit and GTA$100,000
